{"metadata":{"description":"A Multitask "shock absorber" plugin & agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the main chat only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds all run inside subagent contexts. Four worker types, an approval gate, zero DSH source c","id":"gh:1408657362","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-multitask","slug":"Senguk520/dsh-multitask","topics":["agent-preset","context-engineering","context-management","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","multitask","subagents"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A Multitask "shock absorber" plugin & agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the main chat only pl"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds all run "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"inside subagent contexts. Four worker types, an approval gate, zero DSH source c"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"The Multitask "shock absorber" mode for DeepSeek Harness — the main conversation never touches your "},{"id":"p2s2","text":"task "shock absorber" mode for DeepSeek Harness — the main conversation never touches your codebase."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文 · Design notes and measured evidence · MIT License"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A work mode for **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** in which **the main conversation does exactly three things"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"**: understand what you asked for, turn it into task briefs, and report back what the Subagents conc"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"luded. Every piece of process data — file contents, command output, build logs, search results, dead"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" ends — is digested inside a **Subagent's context** and never enters the main one. The main conversa"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"tion therefore holds only high-value information."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This is a **mechanism**, not a prompt asking the model to behave. Once the mode is selected, the mai"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"n conversation (the coordinator) genuinely has a narrower tool surface: the tools that would drag in"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" process data — writing files, running commands, searching the web — are **not in its visible set**."},{"id":"p5s4","text":" It cannot call them, so it cannot pollute its own context. A Subagent (worker) is the opposite: it "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"gets the full tool surface, does the work, and returns only its conclusion."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Zero runtime dependencies. No changes to DSH source."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"At a glance:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Capability | What it gives you |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Narrowed coordinator tool surface | the main conversation cannot write, run commands or search — t"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"hose tools are genuinely absent, not merely discouraged |
| Process data never reaches the main conv"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ersation | file contents, command output, build logs and dead ends stay inside a worker's context |
"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"| Four kinds of Subagent | a full-surface worker, a fork that inherits completed turns, a programmat"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ic PTC worker and a read-only worker, chosen by task shape |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it differs from other modes"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| | Main conversation (coordinator) | Subagent (worker) |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Tool surface | read-only checks + delegation + result retrieval + interaction | full (write files,"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" run commands, build, search…) |
| Context | your request + task briefs + conclusions | all the proc"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ess data |
| Job | understand, translate, dispatch, verify, report | do the work |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"What the coordinator keeps (a whitelist):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Read-only checks** — `read` `grep` `glob` `file_info`
- **Delegation** — `subagent` `subagent_fo"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"rk` `subagent_ptc` `subagent_minimal`
- **Subagent control** — `send_message` `interrupt_agent` `lis"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"t_agents`
- **Result retrieval** — `job_list` `job_output` `job_kill`
- **Orchestration** — `workflo"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"w`
- **Interaction and self-management** — `ask_user_question` `todo_write` `create_goal` `get_goal`"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" `update_goal` `exit_plan_mode` `present` `skill`"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Anything not on that list is withheld by default — `write`, `edit`, `pwsh`, `web_search`, `web_fetch"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"`, `read_image`, `ssh_*`, `task_board_*`, `plugin_manager`, and so on. The rule is a **complement**:"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" withheld = currently visible − kept. Any tool the host adds later is therefore also withheld from t"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"he coordinator by default, with no change needed in this plugin."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The read-only tools are kept on purpose: the coordinator is meant to **verify** a Subagent's claims "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"independently instead of trusting them blindly."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Mode isolation: it only narrows its own sessions"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The narrowing is applied only to sessions whose live preset binding is this preset. A session belong"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ing to another mode in the same workspace keeps its own tool roster and is not touched — so you can "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"run several modes side by side without them eating each other's tools."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### What a worker does not get"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The four kinds also differ in **persona**, not only in tool surface. A fork worker is told that the "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"seeded turns are the coordinator's work and not its own, so it reviews instead of pretending to have"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" done it. A PTC worker is told that its closing message is the fallback channel if `run_code` breaks"},{"id":"p21s4","text":". The read-only worker is told it may search and fetch the web, so it does not report back that it ""},{"id":"p21s5","text":"cannot look anything up"."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"On top of that, five delegation tools — `subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `subagent_ptc`, `subagent_minim"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"al`, `subagent_preset` — are removed from a worker's tool catalog outright, for every kind except th"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"e read-only worker. A worker therefore cannot delegate: the tool is **not there** rather than presen"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"t-and-refused. This costs no capability, because the host's fixed depth of 1 would refuse every such"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" call anyway; it only stops that schema being re-sent on every single request. The coordinator is un"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"touched by this, and the read-only worker is narrowed by its own allowlist instead."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"This is **not a security boundary** — the real block is the host's depth limit. If it fails to insta"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ll it degrades silently, leaving only a log line containing `WORKER-GUARD-SKIPPED`, and nothing is l"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ost functionally. Its switch is the `worker-guard` row's `config.enabled` in `presets/multitask/comp"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"osition.mjs` (which also accepts an additive `config.extraDeny`), and changing it requires a restart"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"sition.mjs` (which also accepts an additive `config.extraDeny`), and changing it requires a restart."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"If a worker's persona cannot be installed at all, that worker keeps the coordinator persona and the "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"log shows `WORKER-PERSONA-SKIPPED`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### What the approval card shows"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The card may be shown a path that contains `..`. When that changes where the path really lands, the "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"reason line and both displayed descriptions carry the **resolved target** next to the literal one, t"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ogether with the id of the rule that matched — so you approve the destination, not just the spelling"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"gether with the id of the rule that matched — so you approve the destination, not just the spelling."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Authorisation is **one-shot**: "Allow once" authorises that call only, and the same call prompts aga"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"in next time. There is no "always allow"."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Level 1 never pre-empts an upstream decision. It runs **after** the downstream handlers and only upg"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"rades an `allow` into an `ask`; if something earlier in the chain already said `ask` or `deny`, that"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" verdict stands and this module's card does not appear — so a write may be stopped by a different pr"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ompt than this module's."}],"truncated":true}
